date_note: Netzwoche (19 November) says Alertswiss warned in the night to Wednesday (18 November) that emergency numbers might be limited, with the all-clear on Wednesday morning; no page read gives the day the attack began. SRF reported the data theft on 20 November.
title: Canton Basel-Landschaft says data on about 97,000 cross-border commuters was taken in cyberattack
summary: Canton Basel-Landschaft told SRF a massive, broad cyberattack on its administration was stopped quickly, but one file was taken; SRF reports it holds about 97,000 records of cross-border commuters, Netzwoche that the canton said probably 97,000. Netzwoche reported on 19 November that about twenty applications, including the tax calculator, were hit and six servers were being reinstalled. The canton filed a criminal complaint against unknown persons.
plain: Swiss canton Basel-Landschaft says a file with data on about 97,000 cross-border commuters was stolen. It warns those affected to watch for phishing.
exec: A cantonal administration lost a file on about 97,000 people; affected people face phishing and identity-theft risk, per the canton.
action: Affected cross-border commuters: be careful with phishing attempts, as the canton warns.

evidence.quote: Bei einem Cyberangriff auf die Verwaltung des Kantons Basel-Landschaft haben Unbekannte rund 97'000 Datensätze
Am Mittwochmorgen erfolgte jedoch bereits die Entwarnung.

validation.note: Two publishers, SRF and Netzwoche, each relay the canton's statement that cross-border commuters' data was taken. The canton's own press page answered 403 to the follow-up run; Badische Zeitung also answered 403 earlier.

review.note: Compared title, 97,000 records, one file taken, about 20 applications and six servers, criminal complaint, phishing warning, date note, status and validation against SRF and Netzwoche. Remaining script warning figure-no-evidence is a false positive: the quote writes 97 with a Swiss apostrophe.
